title: Predictable randomness via Random.nextInt (kotlin) — review required
description: The kotlin call Random.nextInt draws from a non-cryptographic generator. Its output is predictable from past values or seed, so tokens, nonces, and temporary secrets built on it can be guessed. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms the value is non-security or switches to SecureRandom.
remediation: Draw security values from SecureRandom. Keep the fast generator only for simulations, games, and sampling with a comment saying so.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches any Random.nextInt call regardless of purpose; no-arg generator forms are separate rules.
